data.exact_reserve_text:
The 2012, 2013 and 2014 years of account have all shown a profit, with syndicate 1200 being the only syndicate showing a loss. The incoming 2011 and 2012 years of account of RITC produced a technical surplus following continuing favourable incurred development at an attritional level in a number of classes as well as favourable developments on certain individual losses.

2014 continued to show stability of our reserves on all syndicates reinsured into syndicate 2008 with all syndicates reporting a profit, with the exception of syndicate 1200. Syndicate 1200 continues to demand the claims and reinsurance teams' high level of attention, to those claims where we are a lead or an agreement party.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Produced a technical surplus following continuing favourable incurred development at an attritional level.
Produced a technical surplus following continuing favourable incurred development at an attritional level and favourable developments on certain individual losses.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 348.328m (balance sheet, 2013 comparative). The report does not publish a single gross prior-year reserve movement figure; narrative commentary describes favourable incurred development on incoming RITC years (2011 and 2012) and overall profit for the 2012, 2013 and 2014 years of account, indicating net favorable prior-year development (releases) but no quantified gross PYD is provided. Reinsurance to Close activity and RITC recoveries are noted as contributors to the favourable outcome.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities, Claims outstanding) 2013 comparative column. No gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note was found in the supplied pages; only narrative references to favourable development and RITC surpluses are present. Therefore no quantified gross prior-year development amount could be extracted (prior_year_development_gbp_m = null). Segmental premium mix taken from the 'Segmental analysis' table (2014 calendar year). Reinsurance to Close (RITC) activity is mentioned and may distort development measurements; no gross claims development triangle was found in the supplied pages.
